liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **So Many Roads** (2 reviews): Listener valued the performance solely for this song, dismissing the rest as historically significant but poor; Listener called this song a diamond in the rough, noting it was emotionally difficult to hear [13][23]
- **Childhood's End** (1 review): Listener highlighted Phil's strong performance on this track, along with Unbroken Chain and Box of Rain [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1995-07-09.aud.mahoney.86405.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 157 min; rated 2/5 by 18 [1]
- **gd1995-07-09.127735.nick.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 165 min; rated 1.4/5 by 5 [2]
- **gd95-07-09.sbd.7233.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 152 min; rated 3.06/5 by 361 [7]. Said about its sound: Listener found the recording somewhat sad and not too good, though less disastrous than others; Listener rated the recording quality highly but found the performance painful and terrible overall [12][16]
- **gd1995-07-09.aud.liberated-bootleg.larson.27977.flac16**: audience recording; 19 songs; 166 min; rated 2.38/5 by 8 [3]

## Around the show

- Listener attended their second show, finding Jerry and the band sounded great and enjoyable [19]
- Listener attended their first show when Touch of Grey was new, describing this concert as a bummer [21]
- Listener identified So Many Roads as Jerry's goodbye performance [22]
- Listener considered this gig worse than the 1995 Shoreline run and the band's final performance [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-07-09.aud.mahoney.86405.flac16**: taped by Mike Mahoney; transferred by Mike Mahoney; source: ? > Patch > Sony D6 > Master Cassette [1]
- **gd1995-07-09.127735.nick.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Nick; source: 3 source matrix from mix of audience source id 95445, soundboard source id 114369, and audience source id 86405 [2]. Also: Uploader listed the setlist, noting an asterisk for When I Paint My Masterpiece [2]
- **gd95-07-09.sbd.7233.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [7]. Also: Listener noted the recording quality was great, despite the band's health issues affecting their playing [23]
- **gd1995-07-09.aud.liberated-bootleg.larson.27977.flac16**: transferred by Chris Larsen; source: Bootleg "To The Sky: Jerry's Last Show" (probably AUD FOB) [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Soldier Field - July 9, 1995](https://www.dead.net/show/july-9-1995) [25]
- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead Original 1995 Final Tour Poster Framed *POSTER ONLY* | #1948030010](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-original-1995-final-1948030010) [26]
